snippet.title: Mastertronic Presents: 10 Second Ninja Launch Trailer [Censored]
snippet.description:
Check it out on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/271670/

Become the ultimate Ninja and save the world very, very quickly in this time-attack puzzle platformer. Ready, steady, Ninja!

Evil robots from outer space have come to eliminate you, the world's greatest (and only) Ninja. To survive you must destroy each wave of opponents within 10 seconds. Use your katana, shriukens and the laws of physics to take them down.

www.10secondninja.com
